newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn drop, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy and corn drop, wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers were higher on Monday, corn offers were down slightly, and soft and hard red winter wheat values were unchanged, dealers said.
The soybean basis was up in response to fluctuations in the July/August spread, U.S. exporters said.
U.S. soybean export markets remained quiet as importers continued to wait for flat prices to fall.
Corn basis offers slipped a bit in line with a fall in CBOT futures. Prospects for a good crop continued to weigh on the market, traders said.
